verdict.rationale: CrewAI's official CLI documents a create command that scaffolds a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project. The docs also provide a ready-to-paste setup prompt for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor that installs the official CrewAI skills and checks the CLI, which directly covers the ai-native, coding-agent-driven side of the story. missing for 10: the exact one-command scaffold syntax and generated project structure are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of a coding agent scaffolding a project through the CLI.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a coding agent scaffold a new agent project from an official CLI or template in one command

citations.quote: Create a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project.
The CrewAI CLI provides a set of commands to interact with CrewAI, allowing you to create, train, run, and manage crews & flows

Copy a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any coding agent. It installs the official CrewAI skills, checks the CLI, and points the agent at the right docs before it edits code.
Run the following command to install crewai CLI: uv tool install crewai
